text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I find Super Creek in the
library.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fancy seeing you here. Are you on
the hunt
for a book too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for a reference book to help
with my
world history and classic
literature homework.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... there are so many
options, the
moment I think I've made a
choice, another
goody pops out.
choice_data_list_en: Did you find a good book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... if it's all right with you, I could
help you
search!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi there, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the sudden interjection. I just
happened
to overhear your
conversation, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! I'd really appreciate your
help. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! As the student library assistant,
I'm
confident I'll find you the perfect
publication!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well, right off the bat, I think this
reference book
might be just what you
need!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It has plenty of annotations on relevant

terminology, and it's full of diagrams
too, making
it a pretty easy read, I think!
There's even some
funny trivia
included...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds absolutely perfect.
You've really
sold me on it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, s-sorry for rambling on like that!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, don't worry! It's lovely that you
have
something to be passionate about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We should believe in our passions and
keep
working at them, because they're
something to be
proud of. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you very much... That's
encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to study more from your

recommendations, Rob Roy. Can we
keep looking
around? ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I do have some other ideas, so
let's see
how the other books compare!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them continue their
search.
But before long...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? What happens next?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... "But they still couldn't pull out
the giant
carrot. That's when they
decided to work
together and..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, is that... a picture book?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry! I saw this book and
thought it
would be great for the kids,
so... here I am...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It does look like a nice picture book. I
can
imagine it, too... children smiling at
story time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... but I'll have to save that for
another day! I
came here to find a
reference book.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right then, world history... world
history...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Oh, goodness me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, I think I've found the perfect
picture
book for you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: For... me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The blurb says it's about a hero who
vanquishes a
terrible dragon. ♪ Oh, it
sounds fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's one we recently got in stock! I haven't been able to read it yet, but I think... no, I know I'll love the story!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. I figured as much. I'll read it to
you as
many times as you want. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! What am I doing? I'm
sorry I
keep getting distracted.
choice_data_list: 読み聞かせ……聞きたいなぁ……
choice_data_list_en: We have to find some reference books!
A story reading... I'd love to listen in...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's... it's my fault too for getting so
excited...
Okay, we have to get serious
with our search!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right, classical literature... classical
literature...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ooh... This one's called The Dogfather and the Stray Wolf. It might be nice for story time too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't think that's the type of
"dogfather"
you're thinking about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm very sorry! I'm so silly sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek continues her search for a
reference
book, all the while struggling
against her
nurturing tendencies.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm quite happy to read it to you as
well,
Trainer. Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "A long, long time ago, a dreadful dragon attacked a poor village and caused ever so much trouble for the townsfolk..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Creek's voice is so calming. I suddenly
feel so...
relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. Go ahead and take a little nap,
it's fine.
There, there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a refreshing story time, Super
Creek
resumes her book hunt with a
renewed sense of
purpose.
